title: Triage velocity notepad — morning speedrun
content:
Quick context
- 30m speedrun before standup. Focus on highest-customer-impact items and anything blocking CS handoffs.
- Current hotlist: heatmap filter dropping rows, slow dashboard load spikes ~11:20-11:40 UTC, missing traces for customer acme-inc.

Open questions / assumptions
- Are heatmap filters failing only on dashboards with time-range = last 7d? unclear. Might be related to recent rollout to query cache layer (PR 415).
- Spike window looks like nightly reindex + a couple of bursty embedding jobs from ingest-worker-prod. Need to confirm.

Immediate triage checklist (timeboxed)
1) Reproduce heatmap filter bug locally (10m)  - Steps: open /dash/observability/heatmap -> apply filter "region:eu-west" -> dataset shrinks to 0 rows (expected ~120).  - Quick check: try same filter in query inspector -> run raw SQL against analytics cluster.  - Command notes: kubectl -n analytics exec -it svc/psql -- psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE region='eu-west' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';"  - If query returns rows but dashboard shows 0 -> suspect frontend filter mapping or backend response shape change.  - TODO: capture browser network tab and paste payload into Slack thread #observability-bugs.

2) Dashboard slow loads (10m)  - Symptom: dashboards N+ are slow (5-8s) during 11:20-11:40 UTC windows.  - Quick checks:    * Check rollout traffic -> redwoodctl routing get --service analytics-cache (are we routing to new cache nodes?)    * Correlate with reindex jobs: JIRA OBS-987 notes reindex schedule at 11:15 UTC daily.    * If correlation confirmed -> propose short-term mitigation: shift reindex to 02:00 UTC or throttle.  - TODO: ping infra on-call (Isla) to see if we can temporarily throttle reindex jobs.

3) Missing traces for acme-inc (customer report) (10m)  - Customer says traces for request id starting with "acme-20260311-" missing since yesterday.  - Initial hypothesis: retention / sampling policy changed when we flipped new sampler (PR 398).  - Quick steps: search traces index: curl -s "https://trace-search.internal/v1/search?q=acme-20260311" | jq '.hits.total'  - If 0 results -> check ingestion pipeline logs for sampler warnings (grep "sampler" /var/log/trace-ingest/*.log).  - If ingestion shows errors -> open urgent bug and attach logs to ticket for CS.

Follow-ups / owners
- Heatmap filter: owner = Jonah Park. Add network capture + minimal repro GIF. Due: EOD today. Linked to OBS-221 (investigation ticket).
- Dashboard load spikes: owner = Marta Ruiz (me). Draft mitigation proposal and Slack the infra on-call. Due: today 16:00 UTC.- Reindex schedule proposal -> if infra agrees, open change PR to move to 02:00 UTC.- Missing traces (acme-inc): owner = Isla Gomez. Priority: high (customer impact). Assign to OBS-987 and loop CS with initial findings.

Notes to self / quick heuristics
- If frontend shows empty result but raw query returns rows -> first suspect: serialization/shape change in API response (look at keys: data.rows vs rows).- Always capture full request payload and response headers (x-request-id, route, model-version) before restarting services.

Short log snippets to paste (copy me):
- "Observed heatmap filter returning empty payload for region=eu-west; raw SQL returns 119 rows; suspect response shape mismatch after cache layer rollout. Attaching network capture and timeline."
- "Acme customer traces missing for ids 'acme-20260311-*'; ingestion pipeline shows sampler WARN 03:22:15. Assigning to obs-ingest team for deeper logs."

Meeting / comms plan
- Standup: 09:30 local (I will call out heatmap and acme missing traces).- If infra confirms reindex correlation, escalate to Ops lead (J. Alvarado) and propose immediate throttle.

Quick todo (in order)
- [ ] Capture repro + network payload for heatmap (Jonah)
- [ ] Run raw SQL vs dashboard query to compare shapes (Marta)
- [ ] Ping infra on-call about reindex throttling (Isla)
- [ ] Search trace index and attach logs to OBS-987 (Isla)
- [ ] Draft short customer-facing note for CS summarizing actions (Jonah)

Loose ideas (defer to retro)
- Add an automated health alert that flags dashboard query timeouts during reindex windows (could be rule-based; ties to Optimize suggestions).
- Consider temporary read-only cache fallback for dashboards during heavy upstream jobs.

Random notes / scribbles
- Could the new cache serialization rotate field names? Check PR 415 diff: serializer -> renamed "rows" to "dataRows"? if so, frontend mapping needs change.
- If change is small, prioritize hotfix vs rollback depending on risk/time.

End of speedrun. Will expand into proper bug reports after standup.

-- marta
